results.question_text: Ref: Detail 13/A8.23, 9/A8.23, 5/A8.11 Per detail 5/A8.11 face of roof screen metal panel is to align with face of horizontal louver blades however, per details 9/A8.23 and 13/A8.23, different dimensions are provided from face of wide flange to face of metal panels and louvers. This causes misalignment as metal panels transition to louvers at the roof screen especially on the south side roof screen as these metal panels are to align with the penthouse metal panels. Please advise on a proposed solution to maintain alignment between the penthouse metal panels, roof screen metal panels and louvers on the south elevation.

summary.one_line: Coordination gap regarding wall installation and plumbing support could lead to structural concerns.

actionability.specific_action: Ensure clear communication and verification of wall installation methods and plumbing support to prevent future issues.

results.question_text: Drawing P3-A06-36 indicates that the walls for the women's and men's bathrooms are to be installed on SOD (slab-on-deck). Please confirm whether these walls should instead be placed directly on the concrete slab. The estimated weight of each wall, including framing and drywall, is approximately 775 lbs. Please confirm that plumbing fixtures will be supported by carriers, and that only the partitions will be mounted to the walls. Carrier weight details are attached for reference. Additionally, please clarify whether concrete is intended to be poured between the two wall sections or if that space should remain void. Suggested answer Corgan please clarify: 1. Wall section for women's and men's bathrooms to be installed SOD or directly on the toping slab. 2. Confirm if plumbing fixtures will be supported by carriers, and will be placed on top of the new concrete slab. 3. Confirm if concrete should be poured between the two wall sections.
